svg.aria-label: A lab glovebox on a bench: the anatomy of a den. The sealed cabinet is the agent VM. Two glove ports let you work inside without getting in (Rex over SSH). An airlock with a hand-wheel hatch is the only way keys go in (1Password to the VM). A pressure gauge reads below zero: nothing leaks out. One sealed cable gland runs to a terminal block on the bench (code . and the browse tunnel). A lamp on the lid is vm-up, which keeps the box alive.
